headline: Intesa Sanpaolo Launches €34.5 Billion Offer for Monte dei Paschi
summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has launched a €34.5 billion cash-and-share takeover bid for Italian lender Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena.
why: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest banking group by assets, and Monte dei Paschi is one of the country's historic commercial banks.
